scope: VCVio deprecation migration, stage S7 (plan doc/impl/vcvio-deprecation-migration-plan.md section 7: {PqxdhInitial*, PqxdhAuthenticated*}, PqxdhFinal* and the proof-term-only PqxdhInitializer*, PqxdhComposition*, PqxdhSelected*): restatement of 91 theorems and 2 wrapper definition bodies in 40 of the 56 stage modules in VCVio's forward vocabulary (Pr{let x <- mx}[...] and EvalDistEq), with out-of-build certificates for all 93 (92 inverse-map, 1 textual fallback); 4 transitional twins and their 9 later-stage consumer references; 17 earlier twins without consumers deleted; the S2/S3/S4/S5/S6 twins used by the stage's files switched back; the three amendment A3 bridge sites of stage S4 rewritten; phase B proof rewrites in the 56 stage modules; Lean-only validation.

commits.1ab1a7061d61005de2af501106eb4e9f2e95cf78: Migrate VCVio stage S7 to the forward probability vocabulary
commits.docs: the commit that adds this receipt

owner_decisions.item 4 (decision 2026-10-19): D1-D5 and D8-D11 as recommended in plan section 11; D6 phase B included
owner_decisions.item 5 (decision 2026-10-19, revising D7: Lean-only validation per stage: make check-lean, make check-inventory, the step 7 scans and the certificates; no verify-in-shell, ProVerif, transcript fidelity, cargo, Go or Python checks (check-inventory itself runs getter-profile.py and its test)
owner_decisions.item 6 (decision 2026-10-19, of 2026-10-: amendment A2 item 4 accepted: the final acceptance check counts deprecated statement heads, and D6's target is zero facade uses outside the bridge apart from recorded exceptions whose dependency or semantics exists at the pin only in deprecated form
owner_decisions.amendments: A1, A1.1, A2 (items 1-4) and A3 (/tmp/bc-arc-scratch/vcvio-migration/AMENDMENTS.md, recorded in the plan copy)
owner_decisions.wrapper_decision: PqxdhInitialRootEventSecrecy.loss, V-consumed by the S8 definition PqxdhAdaptiveCoordinateSecrecy.targetLoss, keeps its name and type and has no twin (amendment A3 item 1(a), S5 precedent for modifiedNonceAeadINTCTXTAdvantage); targetLoss only applies it, no later proof needs its old body (window scan and full build), so no consumer-site patch was needed; PqxdhAuthenticatedInitialComposition.rootLoss has no later consumer

restated.textual_fallback_note: its old statement elaborated the left distribution at Result × (RawCtxSharedPrimitive.SharedState A × (N × C)) and the right one at Result × PqxdhInitialNativeRetained.RetainedState A N C, two spellings of one type; EvalDistEq has one element type, so the inverse map cannot rebuild the record (as for S6's RawCtxPendingChildRealization.random)
restated.earlier_twins_removed_note: their last consumers were S7 modules, which now use the restated theorems directly; their generated helpers went with them and their check-inventory.sh pins were retired
restated.a3_sites: the three S7 sites of amendment A3 item 2 rewritten in the forward vocabulary: PqxdhAuthenticatedRoot.sourceGame_filtered_eq_initializerReal (privateSourcePrefix_borrowed_complete applied by EvalDistEq.trans), PqxdhAuthenticatedRootSource.nativeNext_eq_total and PqxdhInitialRootEventSource.nativeNext_eq_total ((compatible _ supported).bind_left); no VCVioLegacy use remains at these sites

lean_changes.statements: probOutput -> Pr{let x <- mx}[x = a]; probEvent -> Pr{let x <- mx}[p x]; 𝒮[A] = 𝒮[B] -> EvalDistEq (A) (B) (amendment A1, no =ᵈ; converted from the exact bracket delimiters before the codemod by edits/scripts/spmf_eq.py, three multi-line statements re-laid out by edits/scripts/evaldisteq_layout.py)
lean_changes.elaboration_limits: generic-monad lemmas applied to concrete games over $ᵗ FullOutput reached the recursion limit or the heartbeat limit (no memory runaway; every scoped single-file check stayed at 3.3-4.3 GB); fixed in the proofs only by generalizing the uniform draw before rewriting (PqxdhInitialPreparedResources.parent_collision, PqxdhInitialPreparedRisk.collision_bound, PqxdhInitialSourceLaterMixture.collision_bound, PqxdhInitialFutureInputCandidates.masked_probability) or the event mass (PqxdhInitialSourceLaterSecrecy.normalized_bound: unifying the large Pr{} terms took 62 s and exceeded the heartbeat limit; with the mass generalized the module checks in 10 s)
lean_changes.simp_bridge_exclusions: the facade probe of the first full build found PqxdhInitialFutureInputCandidates.clear_bound and PqxdhInitialSampledParent.local_bound reaching evalDist_apply_singleton through full simp; now simp only / simp with -evalDist_apply_singleton, -evalDist_apply_setOf, -evalDist_apply_univ
lean_changes.editing: S7/edits/work copies (originals in S7/edits/orig): spmf_eq.py, then the pin codemod tools/codemod/pin_codemod.py, then scripted (edits/scripts/e/*.py) and hand edits; layer-by-layer scoped single-file compiles into an overlay of the base build, then full builds in the clone

build.command: make -C beaconcrypt-core check-lean SHELL=bash (proof shell, two-file flake copy of central's flake.nix/flake.lock), every Lean run in a memory-capped coord.sh lease scope, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=6
build.iterations: check-lean-1 rc 0 on the first full build; check-lean-2 rc 0 after the two gate G5 fixes (simp-bridge exclusions)

spmf_only_report.what: declarations whose type or definition body references SPMF but no deprecated statement head (report only)

allowed_generated.note: generated auxiliary declarations of explained parents (restated, edited or twin declarations); type_changed_unexpected and levels_changed list every change outside the configured allowlist, the gate criterion is unexplained_type_changes and unexplained_levels_changes
